background: The Vice-President is a constitutional office under Article 63 and is the ex officio Chairman of the Council of States under Article 64.[1][6]
Under Article 65, the Vice-President acts as President during a vacancy in that office or discharges the President’s functions when the President is unable to do so.[1][6]
The official release concerns a planned two-day visit to Andhra Pradesh, with engagements in Vijayawada, Tirupati and Tiruchanur.
